title: Channel protocol
description: The channel extension point's calls (docs/extensions/channels.md "4. Contributing a channel", version 1): the program hands the hub the owner's messages (channel.receive) and, without a connector, its own state (channel.status); the hub sends the answers, notes, questions and pushes back (channel.send), and shows typing (channel.typing) or edits a message it sent (channel.edit) when the channel's capabilities say it can. The program only talks to its chat app: following the turn, splitting the answer and asking are the pipeline's. Every params object carries contribution, the channel's id. Plugin-side: only the hub and the program speak it.

ChannelErrorCode.description: error.code a program answers besides the base ErrorCode: cannot_send, nowhere to send to yet (before the owner's first message). Another failure of channel.send is tried again after 1, 2 and 4 seconds with the same ref.

ChannelState.description: ChannelStatusParams.state: bound and taking messages, not bound or not set up, or in error (say why in error).

ChannelSendKind.description: What a message the hub sends is: the turn's answer, a note of the hub's own, a question (asks: text), a push the owner did not ask for.

ChannelReceiveParams.description: channel.receive: one of the owner's messages (only the owner's). Answered once the hub has it, deduplicated by id and queued, not after the turn.

contribution.description: The channel's id. The hub takes the extension's only channel when it is left out; always send it.

ChannelMessage.description: At most 4 images of 3 MB and files of 50 MB each, and the hub hands on at most 40 MB of them together; what does not fit is dropped and said in unsupported. A message with nothing in it (no text, images, files, quote, forward or unsupported) is not handed on.

id.description: The chat app's id of the message: the same message delivered again is taken once.

quote.description: The text of the message it quotes.

reply_to.description: The chat app's id of the message it answers.

unsupported.description: What it had that the channel cannot bring, for people (a voice message, a sticker).

ChannelStatusParams.description: channel.status: how a channel without a connector is doing (one with a connector says it through the connector's status).

error.description: One sentence for people; never a secret or a message's body.

ChannelAccount.description: Who the channel is bound to, for display.

ChannelSendParams.description: channel.send: one message to the owner. text is Markdown, already split to the channel's max_text (a plain channel gets plain text). The same ref again is the same message: send it once, answer the same.

ChannelSendResult.description: channel.send's answer: the chat app's id of what was sent, for channel.edit.

ChannelEditParams.description: channel.edit (capabilities.progress): replace the text of a message sent before.
